caption: I spend my days helping other families apply for grants. My own family's support isn't a grant, it's a line item I've never once skipped. Is this what your twenties look like too?

slides.title:
How I spend
my R19 800
p/m salary
Living in Thohoyandou
slides.body:
Female, 28
Single, no kids of her own
Job: Social worker, Department of Social Development
Net salary: R19 800 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: Backyard room near the office, water and lights
slides.body: I could live at home for free. I need four walls that are only mine at the end of a work day.

slides.title: Family support
slides.includes: My mother's disability grant top-up, her medication, my two younger siblings' school transport and lunch money
slides.body: It's the line that grows every time something goes wrong at home, and something always does.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: My own shop, plus what I take home on weekends
slides.body: I buy for one and leave with bags for four.

slides.title: Transport
slides.includes: Taxi to the office, plus the trip home to the village most weekends
slides.body: The weekend trip home costs more than most of my week combined.

slides.title: Airtime & data
slides.includes: Calling my mother every day, coordinating her clinic appointments
slides.body: Non-negotiable. Some weeks it's the only check-in she gets.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Funeral policy for the family, a stokvel with three colleagues, electricity, clothing account, savings
slides.body: Five small things that all quietly assume there's a version of me with money left over.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R19 800. I help other families access grants all day at work. Budgeting my own family's support is the part nobody trained me for.

slides.title: I stopped guessing what home actually cost me
slides.body:
I uploaded three months of statements to Beyond Horizon and finally saw my own family support as one number instead of a blur of small transfers.

R4 900 a month, most months more.

No bank login needed.
